summary: Iter25 frontend regression — verified (a) the P0 bugfix: 'Marketing Videos' link now visible in the super-admin sidebar with data-testid=nav-marketing-videos (from lib/nav.js line 39), gated to roles=['superadmin']; and (b) the 5 code-quality refactors (Layout.jsx → AppSidebar + AppHeader + lib/nav.js; TransparencyCard.jsx → PortalBadge/SlugEditor/LivePortalBlock; and 3 backend helpers) did NOT regress the frontend behaviour. Playwright end-to-end coverage: super-admin login with TOTP → dashboard renders → header shows company name 'Demo Salone Ltd.', tier badge 'Salone HCM Enterprise', country label 'Republic of Sierra Leone' — all 3 testids present after Layout.jsx split. Marketing Videos sidebar link clicks through to /admin/videos, page renders admin-videos-page + admin-videos-search + admin-videos-add. Full CRUD verified end-to-end: create RegressionTestVideo1 (youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ), row appears; toggle publish flips Published→Draft pill and back; delete opens admin-videos-delete-modal and removes the row. Mobile viewport (375x800) — sidebar-open shows the drawer (translate-x-0), sidebar-close hides it (-translate-x-full). Gov-admin login → /settings renders transparency-card with SlugEditor (transparency-slug), Publish/Unpublish button, LivePortalBlock (transparency-live-block + transparency-open) — all sub-components mount cleanly. /civil-service loads without redirect, sidebar 'Civil Service' entry still present. Billing page: plan cards render; selecting 'Professional' plan reveals PaymentMethodCard with 'Card / Stripe' rail marked INTERNATIONAL (method-stripe testid + stripe-btn testid). No console errors from any refactored component. Test data cleaned up (RegressionTestVideo1 deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: lib/nav.js — single source-of-truth NAV array + filterNavForUser(user, has) is a clean refactor. Line 39 correctly gates Marketing Videos with roles=['superadmin'] so it never leaks to tenant admins. Verified gov-admin does NOT see this link in previous iter24 tests.

AppSidebar.jsx (77 lines) — NavLink loop derives data-testid via label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g,'-') → 'Marketing Videos' → nav-marketing-videos ✓. Note: any future NAV label containing digits will be stripped by the regex (harmless today; something to remember when adding new nav items).

AppHeader.jsx (40 lines) — preserves header-company-name, header-tier-badge, and header-company-country data-testids exactly as before the refactor. sidebar-open button correctly hidden on lg+ via lg:hidden.

Layout.jsx (53 lines, down from ~178) — clean shell orchestrator. Route-change → setMobileOpen(false) effect preserved. Sidebar props are all plain data (items, user, mobileOpen, onClose, onLogout) — no logic leakage into presentational component. Good separation of concerns.

TransparencyCard.jsx — extraction of PortalBadge/SlugEditor/LivePortalBlock sub-components is clean; data-testids preserved (transparency-card, transparency-slug, transparency-publish, transparency-unpublish, transparency-live-block, transparency-open, transparency-update-slug). Nice: the clipboard fallback in copy() logs + toasts instead of silently failing.

pages/admin/Videos.jsx — FormPanel opens/closes cleanly; PATCH-with-full-body on publish toggle is a slight over-fetch but backend accepts it (per iter24 report) — acceptable trade-off for simplicity.

Billing.jsx — PaymentMethodCard only renders after selectedPlan is set. This is intentional UX (nothing to pay for until a plan is chosen), but worth noting because a naive 'load billing page → expect Stripe rail' test will fail on first paint. Suggest adding a hint in the empty-selection state that 'Select a plan to see payment options'.

Minor: dashboard console shows a 401 on the first navigation (before the auth cookie/CSRF token round-trips) and two 403s on gov-admin dashboard for polling endpoints that gate on higher tier — these are pre-existing and did not affect any tested flow.
